name: Rogue Valley

climate: Pinot Noir and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A large Southern Oregon AVA covering the Rogue River valley and its tributary valleys, such as the Applegate. Its eastern part is the warmest and driest, and Pinot Noir is its most planted grape, followed by Pinot Gris.
